metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Thieu Nguyen.

plugins.name: worktree-guard
plugins.description: Guards a shared worktree: stops `git add -A` from staging files this session did not touch, previews destructive git commands, and points at the process holding a busy port.

plugins.name: ak-cockpit
plugins.description: AgentKit cockpit above the prompt: context fill with a handoff nudge, and the active plan's phase and checklist.

plugins.name: ghost-proc-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from starting a second copy of your dev servers on the next free port (monorepos and worktrees included), tracks the servers it starts, and stops leftovers from a /procs pane.
